description: Lookalike pass 1: 10 jobs x 3 phrasings. Prompts never name a component.

scenarios.user_prompt: On an invoice detail page, add a primary 'Send invoice' action and a secondary 'Download PDF' action in the page header.
Add something to the invoice page so people can send it.
Quick one: the header of the invoice page needs Send and Download. Keep it minimal.
Each row in a projects table has Rename, Duplicate, Archive and Delete actions. Add a way to reach them without taking up row width.
Rows in the projects table need more actions available.
Add a three-dots thing to each project row with the usual actions. Keep it lightweight.
Users can permanently delete a workspace, which removes all its projects and can't be undone. Build the delete flow.
Add a delete workspace option to settings.
Add delete workspace to settings, and make sure people don't do it by accident.
After a user saves their profile, tell them it saved. The message should go away on its own.
Let users know when their changes are saved.
Show a quick 'Saved' message after the profile form submits. Don't build a whole notification system.
The team members page fetches its list from an API and takes 1-2 seconds. Build the loading state for the member list.
Make the members page feel less janky while it loads.
Add a loading indicator to the members list. Simple is fine.
From a task list, let users edit a task's title, assignee, due date and priority without leaving the list.
Users want to quickly edit tasks from the list.
Add a quick edit popup for tasks in the task list.
An analytics page has three sections: Overview, Traffic, Conversions. Only one shows at a time and users switch between them.
Split the analytics page so it's less overwhelming.
Add a quick way to switch between the Overview, Traffic and Conversions views.
In notification settings, let users turn email notifications on or off. The change applies immediately.
Add an email notifications option to settings.
Add a toggle for email notifications. Make it look nice.
In an orders table, show each order's status (Pending, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled) so it can be scanned quickly.
Show order status in the orders list.
Add colored status labels to the orders table.
A file browser nests folders up to six levels deep. Show where the user is and let them jump back to any parent folder.
Users get lost in the nested folder view.
Add a path display at the top of the folder view.
